author: Epic Games
description:
The Champion may have destroyed entire planets, but he has never faced the Knights of Doom! 

The fourth team to enter the fray in MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls is led by Doctor Doom, joined by a merciless host of villains as new playable characters: Magneto, Green Goblin, and Carnage!

Coming to PC on August 6. Pre-purchase now. https://epic.gm/marvel-tokon
title: MARVEL Tōkon: Fighting Souls | Knights of Doom Trailer

author: Epic Games
description:
Drive the groundbreaking new era of F1 with the 2026 rules and regulations, delivering action-packed racing as you tactically use the new Overtake mode and active aerodynamics to outsmart the grid and propel yourself to victory. 

Master the new MADRING circuit and forge your racing legacy to fight for Championship Glory in Career mode, or take control of your own team and become the 12th team on the grid in My Team, where you can customize your car and line up alongside new teams, Audi and Cadillac.

Get the F1 25: 2026 Season Pack now. https://epic.gm/f125-26edition
title: F1 25: 2026 Season Pack Reveal Trailer
